name: moodist
title: Moodist
description: Ambient sound mixer for focus and relaxation. Layer over 80 sounds, save presets, set a sleep timer, and control it all from your menu bar.
author: chandlervdw

commands.name: mix-sounds
commands.title: Mix Sounds
commands.subtitle: Moodist
commands.description: Browse, play, and mix ambient sounds with individual and master volume

commands.name: toggle-playback
commands.title: Toggle Playback
commands.subtitle: Moodist
commands.description: Pause or resume the current mix

commands.name: menu-bar
commands.title: Moodist Menu Bar
commands.subtitle: Moodist
commands.description: Persistent menu bar controls for Moodist

commands.name: manage-presets
commands.title: Manage Presets
commands.subtitle: Moodist
commands.description: Save, load, pin, and delete sound mix presets

commands.name: load-preset
commands.title: Play Preset
commands.subtitle: Moodist
commands.description: Play a saved preset by name. Create a quicklink from Manage Presets to give a preset its own hotkey

commands.name: set-timer
commands.title: Set Sleep Timer
commands.subtitle: Moodist
commands.description: Pause the mix after a set time

commands.name: stop-all
commands.title: Stop All Sounds
commands.subtitle: Moodist
commands.description: Stop every sound and clear the mix

tools.name: list-sounds
tools.title: List Sounds
tools.description: List every Moodist sound with its id, category, and whether it is playing or paused in the mix

tools.name: play-sounds
tools.title: Play Sounds
tools.description: Play one or more Moodist sounds by id, optionally replacing the current mix

tools.name: stop-sounds
tools.title: Stop Sounds
tools.description: Stop specific Moodist sounds and remove them from the mix, or stop everything

tools.name: play-preset
tools.title: Play Preset
tools.description: Replace the current mix with a saved Moodist preset by name

preferences.name: defaultVolume
preferences.title: Default Volume
preferences.description: Volume for a sound you add to the mix

preferences.name: showMenuBarCount
preferences.title: Show Sound Count in Menu Bar
preferences.description: Display the number of active sounds next to the menu bar icon
preferences.label: Show count

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1
